title: Glasswing Midge Cloud
text: A glittering cloud of glasswing midges gathers around signal lenses, scattering false reflections across the route.
flavor: The swarm bites light before it bites skin.

defeatReward.text: You disperse the midges and tune the route lens back to true north.

imagePrompt: A cloud of tiny glass-winged insects around blue route lenses and cold signal lamps, shimmering reflections over black basalt, low-tier anomaly vermin
